tagline: One of Istanbul's most populous outer districts — a dense, diverse, and affordable suburban community with a large international population.

items.name: Esenyurt Çarşı Restoranları
items.description: A diverse range of restaurants reflecting the district's international community — Arabic, African, Central Asian, and Turkish cuisine all represented.
items.tip: The international food scene here is genuinely diverse and very affordable. Worth exploring if you live on the western European side.

tips: Esenyurt is on the M3 metro line — about 40-45 minutes from the city centre.
One of Istanbul's most diverse neighbourhoods with large Arab, African, and Central Asian communities.
Very affordable housing — popular with newcomers to Istanbul.
Not a tourism destination but an interesting window into Istanbul's multicultural reality.
